semantic_definition: Explicit claim that this commit fixes, corrects, or resolves the linked issue
minimum_evidence: P and S establish the relationship; at least one of I or D corroborates; neither I nor D materially contradicts
notes: Assertive language without a present corrective claim is not C1

semantic_definition: No explicit fixing phrase, but present corrective intent is affirmatively and mutually supported
minimum_evidence: I=affirmative and D=affirmative; P and S valid; I and D mutually consistent
notes: Both independent issue evidence and diff corroboration are mandatory

semantic_definition: Related work, provenance-only, housekeeping, diagnostic work, workaround, mitigation, suppression, test-only evidence without a product correction, or a statement that a future commit will fix
contradiction_or_missing_critical_eviden: A separate affirmative correction may move a case to C1/C2; mitigation/suppression alone never does
Missing critical evidence and material contradictions remain unresolved
